longBusinessSummary: Badger Infrastructure Solutions Ltd. provides non-destructive excavating and related services to utilities, industrial, construction, transportation, and other industries in Canada and the United States. It offers Badger Hydrovac for use in safe excavations around critical infrastructure and in congested underground conditions. The company also provides hydrovac services, such as anode installations, daylighting, debris removal, pipelines, potholing, power distribution, service pits, shoring installations, tank cleanouts, trenching, and utility pole holes; and electromagnetic locating, GPS data collection, infrastructure mapping, depth of cover surveys, 4-way sweeps and passive scans, daylight reports, CAD drawings and GIS exports, and watch and protect inspections services.
